title: Solar-powered bioelectrochemical system for efficient cadmium remediation and recovery of reusable solids
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2915-2922
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07856C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yeonu Im, Minsoo Kim, Yuri Kim, Soo Youn Lee, Minkyoung Kim, Tae-Hoon Kim, Jinhee Heo, Changman Kim
A solar-powered bioelectrochemical system integrates a photovoltaic bias with a bioanode to enable cadmium remediation and recovery under mild aqueous conditions, favoring precipitation of Cd–O solids over metallic deposition.
